theorems.statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [HopfAlgebra k H] (A : Subalgebra k H) [Algebra.FiniteType k A] (hΔ : (∀ x ∈ A, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) x ∈ Submodule.span k {t : TensorProduct k H H | ∃ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ A, t = TensorProduct.tmul k a b})) (hS : (∀ x ∈ A, HopfAlgebra.antipode k x ∈ A)) (V : Submodule k H) [FiniteDimensional k V] (h1 : (1 : H) ∈ V) (hV : ∀ x ∈ V, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) x ∈ Submodule.span k {t : TensorProduct k H H | ∃ a ∈ V, ∃ b : H, t = TensorProduct.tmul k a b}), ∃ r : (Submodule.span A (V : Set H)) →ₗ[A] A, ∀ (a : A) (ha : (a : H) ∈ Submodule.span A (V : Set H)), r ⟨(a : H), ha⟩ = a
theorems.natural_summary: Restricts the Hopf structure to A, applies accepted relative Hopf-module projectivity to N/A, and splits the quotient to obtain the retraction.
